title: designpartner golden-fixture suite file (cases.json)
description: Documentation-grade schema for the per-suite cases.json files. Inputs and case names are HAND-WRITTEN; every `expected` block is MACHINE-GENERATED by scripts/gen-designpartner-fixtures.py from the Python reference engine and hand-reviewed before commit. `expected: null` marks a case whose golden output has not been frozen yet.

target.description: The Python reference entry point the generator runs for this suite.

input.description: Suite-specific input. catalog: {answers | answers_file}. validate: {answers | answers_file}. payload: {answers | answers_file, consent, diagnose_docs | diagnose_docs_file?, version?, submitted_at?, confirmed_at?}. state: {state, has_diagnose_run}. cli: {argv, stdin_file?, copy_from_corpus?, pre_argv?, env?} — run in a FRESH temp cwd; `env` is merged into the subprocess environment in the generator AND both parity drivers (how the unroutable TRYAII_DESIGNPARTNER_URL reaches the CLI); expected = {stdout_golden, stderr, exit_code}, and test_designpartner_cli_parity.py additionally byte-compares every file both CLIs write.

expected.description: Machine-generated golden output. null until frozen. catalog: {applicable, required}. validate: {answers, problems, warnings}. payload: the submission document. state: {stage}. cli: {stdout_golden, stderr, exit_code}.
